weeks.memory_verse: “Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits”. Psalm 103:2.
weeks.lesson_introduction: The Psalmist reminded us in Psalm 103 of God's provisions for humanity that should not be winked at, starting with privileges of waking up daily, getting air not being paid for, the human anatomy working effectively, and deliverance from wicked forces and their antics, anyone that rules out this awesome kindness of God should be reminded of John 15:4 that without Him, we are nothing. We should appreciate the Almighty God for not keeping us in darkness, always being prompt in yielding to our daily request and making sure we are not abandoned.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: GOD'S UNDESERVED BENEFITS
outlines.body:
Undeserved benefits refer to all good things God gives us freely, not because we earned them or deserve them, but because of His love, mercy and grace. They can be termed “grace blessings, unmerited favour”.

Daily Provision every day, God unleashes to our paths food, shelter, resources - Matthew 6:26.
Peace of mind - Philippians 4:7.
Deliverance from wicked forces - Psalm 91:3.
Sound health and healing. Psalm 103:3, 3 John 1:2
His Love and Mercy. John 3:16, Lamentations 3:22-23.
Access to God's presence and gratification of requests. Hebrews 4:16, Jeremiah 32:27

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: TO LIVE AND THANK GOD
outlines.body:
When you consider Samson and David, their exploits, longevity, quickness to divine response to their requests, it can be traced to life of gratitude.
David had fulfilling life because he knew how to appreciate God for every blessing received, promises fulfilled, victory accessed, deliverance received and enemies defeated.

David knew where he came from, he understood victory is not by might or armoury, 1 Samuel 17. He also knew that getting success in every endeavor comes from God's love and His abiding presence.

To live and be thankful means:
a. Being victorious, successful and productive:
b. Getting timely response from God:
c. Being repositioned to enviable heights:
d. Being guided and supported: and
e. Being perpetually in thanksgiving.

weeks.conclusion: We are all sinners by nature - Romans 3:23, we could never earn God's favour by our own works, it is only through Grace of God, His unearned kindness that is the reason we should show Him gratitude for His goodness, remember we are nothing without God's grace. You also need to extend love and mercy to others, as God has shown to us.
prayer_points: Father, I thank You for all Your benefits in my life, seen and unseen, known and unknown.
Lord, deliver me from spiritual forgetfulness and ingratitude in Jesus' Name.
O Lord, renew Your benefits in my life daily according to Your Word.
Lord, satisfy my mouth with good things and renew my strength like the eagles.
Lord, as I remember Your benefits, help me to walk in obedience to You.
golden_diet: Remember the ungrateful nine and be the grateful one - Luke 17:17
God redeemed you, don't forget. Romans 5:8
In everything, give thanks to the Almighty God. 1 Thessalonians 5:18.
Never disdain grateful people, you may suffer the consequence.
God's marvelous works should be remembered. 1 Chronicles 16:12
Let the whole world know what God has done. 1 Chronicles 16:8

weeks.memory_verse: “Remember Lot's wife.” Luke 17:32.
weeks.lesson_introduction: Lot's wife may not be known in the bible for many reasons but her tragic end by becoming a pillar of salt has always brought people's attention to her attachment to worldly allures, covetousness and indiscipline, despite angels' strong warning to her family to flee the city and never to look back after God released destruction into Sodom and Gomorrah she disobeyed God and suffered the consequences.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: LESSONS FROM LOT'S WIFE
outlines.body:
a. Never yield to partial obedience, it is dangerous. God said they sgould flee from the city and don't look back.
b. Don't look back once you secure your redemption from the devil - Luke 9:62.
c. Guide your heart away from the past - Proverbs 4:23.
d. Any offer from the devil is a time bomb.
e. Your foundation will be tested at every juncture in life.
f. Her destruction did not stop his family progressing out of danger.
g. Spiritual focus is essential.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: BE FOCUSED
outlines.body:
Lot's wife is a symbol of disobedience, divided loyalty and loss of spiritual focus. Though she left Sodom but her attachment to the beautiful things in that city was still engraved in her heart.
a. Don't yield to the devil's temptation. Proverbs 1:10.
b. Stay on God's direction not on the world's distraction. Solomon's heart went astray - 1 kings 11:1
c. Remember half obedience is disobedience. 1 Samuel 15:22
d. Though the past seems attractive, it is also destructive.
e. Distraction will pull you back to old ways that are cancerous. 2 Timothy 4:10

weeks.conclusion: Remember Lot's wife is a powerful statement to everyone in this Christian race, looking back to the past affiliation to worldliness may end one's journey abruptly. Never attach yourself to the past, don't turn back to what God has delivered you from - 2 Corinthians. 5:17.
prayer_points: Father, deliver me from the spirit of looking back.
Father, give me grace to move forward and never return to my past.
Lord, fix my eyes on Jesus, the author and finisher of my faith.
Every force assigned against me to stop my progress, scatter In Jesus Name.
Father, let my faith remain strong in times of pressure and temptation.
golden_diet: But Lot's wife looked behind her, and she became a pillar of salt. Genesis 19:26
Forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forward for those things which are ahead.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Proverbs 4:25
If anyone draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him. Hebrews 10:38.
He who endures to the end shall be saved. Matthew 24:13.
Never look back once you secure your redemption from the devil. Luke 9:62

weeks.memory_verse: “When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made and knew not whence it was (but the servants which drew the water knew), the governor of the feat called the bridegroom” John 2:9.
weeks.lesson_introduction: The story of the wedding in Cana of Galilee tells us that an unrelenting attitude pays, it yields positive ending, but one major take home in that story is getting Jesus into your daily endeavor. When the wedding was drawing towards a shameful ending due to the exhaustion of resources, His presence changed the ridiculous tune to a miraculous melody. Your then full of wanting, defeat and shame, with Jesus in your now, His influence can rewrite your story to positive vibes.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: THEN, THERE WAS A PROBLEM
outlines.body:
Wine ran out. Wine at the wedding reception represents
Symbol of Joy and celebration, it means then joy and celebration ceased.
Sign of love and unity, it means withdrawal of harmony and being replaced with bitterness.
Toast of good wishes. It means enemy replaced it with bad wishes
There was limitation of resources, insufficiency set in.
There was no rescue from impending shame.
There was interruption from having a good beginning.
The Enemy brought interruption to divine order (be fruitful and multiply).

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: HOW TO CHANGE THEN TO NOW?
outlines.body:
Then, wine stopped but divine leading salvaged the dreadful situation through the mother of our Lord Jesus who prompted Him to restore order to the calamitous situation.

To change then to now;
a. Obey divine instruction. Job 36:11
b. Seek for help, closed mouth is a closed destiny. 2 kings 4:1-7
c. Resist every evil plan to divine order.
d. Get the transformative power.
e. Invite Jesus to your situation and turn emptiness to abundance. Hebrews 13:8.

weeks.conclusion: In John 2:9, Jesus showed miraculous transformation at the wedding in Cana, turning then (impending shame, reproach), with His power, to wine. This symbolizes God's power to bring the best blessings at the right time and the joy of His presence in one's life.
prayer_points: Father, thank you for changing my story from then and now.
Father, let every negative then in my life be swallowed up by a glorious now.
Lord, I refuse to return to what You have already delivered me from.
Lord, please establish my new identity in Christ.
Father, sustain me so I will not fall back to my former ways.
golden_diet: Don't be selfish; don't live to make a good impression on others. Philippians 2:3
For God is very rich in mercy; He loves us so much. Ephesians 2:4
Once you knew very little of God's kindness; now your very lives have been changed. 1 Pet.2:10
Then I was blind but now I see. John 9:25
If any man is in Christ, he is a new creature, old things are gone. 2 Corinthians 5:17.
Follow the steps of Jesus in obedience and suffering. 1 Peter 2:21-23
God will give you back everything you have lost to the adversaries. Joel 2:25

weeks.memory_verse: “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated,” Romans 9:13
weeks.lesson_introduction: Being God's favourite means you are divinely, most preferred above others: And being divinely chosen over others, everyone redeemed by the shed blood of Christ has been given access to divine inheritance and procurement of God's promises, that is why you must do everything in your capacity to be amongst God's favourite who is duly granted provision to enjoy divine benefits others are exempted from.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHO ARE GOD'S FAVOURITES?
outlines.body:
God's favourites are
Humble and teachable. Numbers 12:3.
In deep intimacy with God. Moses's relationship with God is exceptionally special. Exodus 33:11.
Conscious in preserving God's secrets and ensure perfect adherence to His instructions. Hebrews 3:5
Courageous and bold. Hebrews 11:24-26.
Sacrifices earthly gains for divine purposes.
Those that have deep compassion for God's people. Exodus 32:32.
Patient and also endure. They depend on God totally. 2 Timothy 2:3
Vessels unto honour with servant - leader's heart. 2 Timothy 2:21

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: YOU CAN BECOME GOD'S FAVOURITE
outlines.body:
To become God's favourite, you need to:
Walk in obedience. Job 36:11.
Be faithful in small things that are committed to you. Joseph was faithful even in the prison. Luke 19:17
Have a heart of intercession and positive attitude to defend divine cause. 1 Samuel 17:36
Seek God's will above your own. Elisha left all to follow Elijah. 1 kings 19:19-21
Be a deep worshipper. John 4:23-24
Serve others with joy, help those in need. Acts 9:36-42
Have a heart of gratitude. Luke 17:17-19, Psalm 103:1-14

weeks.conclusion: To become God's favourite, cultivate a heart that God can trust, humble, being compassionate, faithful and deeply intimate with Him.
prayer_points: Father, thank you for loving Daddy and Mummy G.O and counting them as Your own.
Lord, let Daddy & Mummy GO and the entire RCCG continue to enjoy your favour.
Lord, remove anything in my life that blocks me from enjoying your favour.
Lord, mark me for distinction by your favour.
Father, preserve me and my household as your favourite.
golden_diet: But Noah found favour in the eyes of the Lord. Genesis 6:8.
You have found favour in My sight and I know you by name, Moses. Exodus 33:17.
And the child Samuel grew in favour both with the Lord and me. 1 Samuel 2:26.
Esther obtained favour in the sight of all who saw her. Esther 2:15.
For You, O Lord will bless the righteous with favour You will surround him as with a shield. Psalm 5:12.
Now God has brought Daniel into the favour and goodwill of the chief of the eunuchs. Daniel 1:9

weeks.memory_verse: “They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war, and they shall march everyone on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks” Joel 2:7
weeks.lesson_introduction: Looking at Joel 2:7-8, A disciple of Christ must be discipline, united, spiritually aligned and be obedient, staying in his or her God given assigned position, an army of Christ are always in right place, no weapon can stop them. God's army are always charged and ready to enforce divine order.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: DIVINE ORDER
outlines.body:
The word divine order means; God's perfect, established arrangement. 1 Corinthians 14:40. Following God obediently in your steps, decisions and relationship, not human impulses. Not confusion. 1 Samuel 16. Samuel followed God's order in making choice of king for the Israelites. Elimination of disorder, unnecessary struggles. 1 Corinthians 14:33

SIGNS OF OPERATING IN DIVINE ORDER.
Experiencing inner peace in decisions and operations. David rejected Saul's garment in fighting Goliath. Everything will fall in place without force or human's inputs. 2 Chronicles 20:1-20.Divine direction step-by-step. Relationships aligning with destiny. Esther followed Mordecai's instructions, she later got divine alignment.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: AVOID SELF GOVERNMENT
outlines.body: Ruling your own life by your wisdom, desires and opinions instead of submitting to God's authority, God's Word and the Holy Spirit is dangerous, doing what is right in your own eyes, Judges 21:25 can bring disconnection from God's guidance, Proverbs 14:12, loss of divine protection, opening door to temptation e.g Samson. Self-government can also lead to poor decision making and regret and easy target to the enemy, therefore desist from it and be in God's favourite agenda.

weeks.conclusion: Following divine order brings peace not anxiety, direction not confusion, progress not stagnation. It helps to avoid mistakes and wasted seasons and positions one for God's blessings and favour.
prayer_points: Father, remove every spirit of pride and rebellion from my heart, and give me submissive spirit.
Lord, help Daddy & Mummy GO to remain in their assigned position.
Father, keep me away from distraction that can cause me to break ranks.
Lord, give me grace to honour and submit to godly authority without murmuring.
Father, align my steps, my decisions, and my actions with Your divine arrangement.
golden_diet: They shall run like mighty men, they shall not break their ranks. Joel 2:7-8.
Let all things be done decently and in order. 1 Corinthians 14:40.
Breaking ranks often begins with rejecting spiritual authority. Hebrews 13:17
Unity preserves strength, division weakens purpose. Psalm 133:1
Breaking ranks is a rebellion in disguise. 1 Samuel 15:23
Pride is a major cause of breaking ranks. Proverbs 13:10.

weeks.memory_verse: “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength” Isaiah 40:29
weeks.lesson_introduction: As we go through the journey of life, enough strength is required, in Isaiah 40:29, bible says Almighty God is always ready to give power to the tired and worn out and strength to the weak, there is none that never suffer exhaustion but we need God's grace to recharge for next assignment. When going through ten virgin's story in Matthew 25:1-10, your readiness to meet the bridegroom is based on having extra in you.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WAIT ON THE LORD
outlines.body:
Waiting on the Lord means trusting, hoping and depending on God when it seems everything is silent and not working according to one's program. When answers are delayed, when inputs are not yielding results, when requests are turned down, when strength is disappearing, you need to wait. Waiting is an act of faith that God will do it. It brings renewal of hope, refreshing to your souls, energizing your inner stamina.

When you wait:
Mistakes are reduced.
Self-confidence is terminated, trust in God is built. Proverbs 3:5-6
Spiritual transformation is triggered. Moses encountered God in Exodus 3
Demonic activities are exposed and tamed. Mordecai waited at the gate and exposed conspiracy against king Ahasuerus that led to his promotion.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: DIVINE EMPOWERMENT
outlines.body:
Every believer desires strength, speed, victory and positive results, but God has a system for empowerment i.e. waiting on the Lord. When you wait, you are renewed according to Isaiah 40:31, you are experiencing an exchange. In Acts 1:8, bible says getting power comes when you have encounter with the Holy Spirit, i.e. having God's presence with you, disciples waited at the upper room before being empowered, therefore you have to be prayerful, full of positive expectations, be addicted to worship, praising God and be rooted in the word of God, all these will bring empowerment.

Divine empowerment brings;
a. Spiritual and physical transformation. Acts 13:1-2
b. Boldness and operating in God's wisdom. Proverbs 28:1, Acts 6:8
c. Destruction of embargoes and evil agenda. Acts 12:3-9
d. Positive changes to lives around you. Acts 28:2-10
e. Establishment of your words being anointed with fire. 2 kings 1:8-15

weeks.conclusion: Strength from God brings transformation from ordinary lives to state of having supernatural strength. When Holy Spirit empowers you, you will rise above fear, weakness and limitations and then you begin to do extraordinary things.
prayer_points: Father, release supernatural strength upon me to overcome every challenge of life.
Lord, let Daddy & Mummy GO be strengthened and renewed for greater assignment.
Lord, grant me enduring strength to stand firm till the end.
I receive power to overcome and to finish well.
Father, silence every force assigned to drain my strength in Jesus name.
golden_diet: Strength is renewed not exhausted in God. Isaiah 40:31
Be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might. Ephesians 6:10
If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small. Proverbs 24:10
Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit, saith the Lord. Zechariah 4:6
In all tribulations and persecution, we are more than conquerors through him that love us. Prov.24:10.
It is God that girdeth me with strength. Psalm 18:32
My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength ismade perfect in weakness. 2 Corinthians 12:9

weeks.memory_verse: “And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God. James 2:23
weeks.lesson_introduction: It may surprise you to know that God has best friends, they are so close to Him that they know things about Him that no one else knows. They are people with experiential knowledge of God that most people don't have. They don't talk deeply on how much they know God so that people will not misunderstand them.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: KNOW THEIR ATTRIBUTES - GOD'S BEST FRIENDS
outlines.body:
Abraham was one of God's best friends, he was so close to God that God said He could not do anything significant on earth without first informing him (Genesis 18:17). Moses was also one of God's best friends, he was so close to God that God Himself testified in Numbers 12:8, that He spoke to Moses mouth to mouth. Their attributes are:

They always say 'yes' to the Lord's command.
They had close relationship with God and saw other sides of God others never saw.
They heard things from God that they never told others and made God change His mind. Gen.18:24-32.
They are people of faith. Hebrews 11:5, 6, Romans 4:18, 19.
They prioritize prayers over complains, they always stand for others in deep intercession. 1 Cor. 3:5-9.
God's best friends are pruned by God till they are genuinely humble. John 15:2

Nobody can get close to God without going through intense discipline.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: KNOW THEIR EXPLOITS - GOD'S BEST FRIENDS
outlines.body:
God's best friends have long standing exploits that are yet to be dethroned such as:
I. Parting of the red sea and safe crossing by the Israelites. Exodus 14:21 22. ii. Bringing water out of the rock. Exodus 17:6. iii. Shutting the mouth of lions. Daniel 6:22. iv. Reading the handwriting on the wall and seeing deep prophetic secrets. Daniel 5:12, Daniel 9-12
v. Multiplying oil for the widow, making an iron head to float. 2 kings 4:1-7, 2 kings 6:5-7. vi. Stopping rain from falling, calling down fire from heaven. 1 kings 17:1, 1 kings 18:36-38

weeks.conclusion: Every person who became God's best friend walked in obedience, intimacy, purity and consistent fellowship. And these led to exploits - things beyond human ability.
prayer_points: Father, reveal Your secrets to me and grant me insight into Your plans.
Father, remove every barrier between You and me and deepen my intimacy with You.
Lord, give me unwavering faith that pleases You and qualifies me as Your friend.
Father, help me to walk with You daily, never to drift from Your counsel.
Father, arise and defend me as Your friend against all oppositions.
golden_diet: Faith and obedience attract divine friendship. James 2:23
God will always reveal His secrets to His friends. Genesis 18:17
God's friend will never be afraid of tricks and manipulation of adversaries. Luke 12:4
Almighty God will never do anything without informing His beloved. Amos 3:7
God's secret is with the righteous. Proverbs 3:32
The secret of the Lord is with them that fear Him. Psalm 25:14
And the Lord spake to Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. Exodus 33:11

weeks.memory_verse: “The Lord is not slack concerning His promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish but that all should come to repentance”- 2 Pet.3:9.
weeks.lesson_introduction: Longsuffering means enduring injury, offense, delay or provocation without revenge. It is patience under pressure. It is the strength to keep loving and forgiving when quitting seems easier. This nature is in God: slow to anger, giving room for repentance. Longsuffering is not weakness; it is controlled strength. Every believer is called to reflect this character.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHY LONGSUFFERING?
outlines.body:
Longsuffering is more than ordinary patience - it is patience with people especially those who hurt, disappoint, misunderstand, or oppose us. It helps a believer to control anger, avoid revenge, and respond with love rather than frustration.
1. It reveals the nature of God. (Psalm 86:15)
2. It preserves unity in families, church and relationships. (Prov. 15:1)
3. It helps our spiritual growth through trials. (James 1:3-4)
4. It is a silent evangelism - it speaks louder than words. (1 Pet. 2:19-23)
5. Because God patiently endured us first. (Rom. 2:4)

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: BENEFITS AND BIBLICAL EXAMPLES
outlines.body:
Benefits:
- Brings peace and emotional stability.
- Restores relationships and prevents bitterness.
- Breaks anger, revenge and malice.
- Protects destinies from wrong decisions.
- Has heavenly reward. (Heb. 6:12)

Examples:
- God endured Israel for generations.
- Noah preached 120 years amid mockery. (Gen. 6-7)
- Joseph endured betrayal and prison. (Gen. 50:20)
- David spared Saul repeatedly. (1 Sam. 24)
- Jesus endured the cross for us. (Isa. 53:7)

weeks.conclusion: Longsuffering is proof of Christ in us. A believer without endurance cannot reflect Jesus fully. As God is patient with our weaknesses, we must extend the same grace to others - in our homes, offices, and church and to the lost. Longsuffering is not optional for believers; it is a kingdom lifestyle.
prayer_points: Thank You Lord for Your patience toward me.
Father, produce longsuffering in me by Your Spirit.
Deliver me from anger and impatience.
Help me to forgive like Jesus.
Let my life reflect Your patience daily.
golden_diet: Longsuffering is a fruit of spiritual maturity. Gal. 5:22
Forgive and forbear others joyfully. Col. 3:12-13
Do not revenge - let God defend you. Rom. 12:17-19
Patience shows wisdom; haste breeds error. Prov. 14:29
Like Job, wait - the end of the Lord is glorious. James 5:7-11
In your patience possess ye your souls. Luke 21:19.
Through faith and patience inherit the promises. Hebrews 6:12

weeks.memory_verse: “But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved” Matthew 24:13 (KJV)
weeks.lesson_introduction: The Christian journey is not a sprint but a marathon. It requires consistency, perseverance, and faithfulness until the very end. Many people start well but lose focus along the way due to distractions, trials, or worldly pleasures. However, God expects every believer to remain steadfast and faithful until the race is fully run. Our eternal reward depends not only on how we start but on how we finish. Paul's testimony at the end of his life challenges every believer to endure to the end in faith, service, and righteousness.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHY FAITHFUL TO THE END?
outlines.body:
Because Salvation is for those who endure to the end. Matthew 24:13 makes it clear that endurance is part of our salvation journey. It's not enough to start well; we must continue and finish well.

To receive the crown of righteousness. Paul looked forward to a reward because he remained faithful (2 Timothy 4:8). There are crowns awaiting those who finish their race faithfully (James 1:12; Rev. 2:10).

Because the Christian race is full of challenges, temptations, persecutions, false teachings, and worldly distractions abound (1 Peter 5:8; 2 Tim 3:12). Only those who hold on to their faith will stand till the end.

To avoid being disqualified after starting well. 1 Corinthians 9:27: Even Paul disciplined himself to avoid being a castaway. Many like Demas started well but ended poorly (2 Timothy 4:10).

To glorify God through our steadfastness. Our endurance is a testimony that brings glory to God (Matthew 5:16; John 15:8).

Faithfulness reveals the power of God working in us to remain true despite trials.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: AREAS TO REMAIN FAITHFUL
outlines.body:
Faithfulness to God and His Word. Stand firm in the truth of the Scriptures (Joshua 1:8; 2 Timothy 3:14-17). Obey His commands, no matter the changing trends of the world (John 14:15)
Faithfulness in Prayer and Fellowship. Do not forsake personal devotion and corporate gatherings (Hebrews 10:25; Luke 18:1). Prayer strengthens our endurance.
Faithfulness in Service. Continue to serve God and others with joy, not slothfulness (Romans 12:11; 1 Corinthians 15:58). God rewards consistent service, even when unnoticed by men.
Faithfulness in Holiness and Righteous Living. Remain pure in heart and conduct (1 Peter 1:15-16; Hebrews 12:14). Avoid compromise, no matter the cost.
Faithfulness in Trials and Persecutions. Stand firm like the three Hebrew boys and Daniel (Daniel 3:16-18; Daniel 6:10). Remember that trials refine faith (1 Peter 1:7).
Faithfulness in Evangelism and Witnessing. Keep sharing the Gospel till the end (Matthew 28:19-20; Acts 1:8). Souls are at stake; our faithfulness could bring many to Christ.
Faithfulness in Giving and Stewardship. Stay committed to tithes, offerings, and supporting kingdom work (1 Corinthians 4:2; Luke 16:10-11). God entrusts more to those who remain faithful in little.

weeks.conclusion: The Christian life is a race that must be run with patience, discipline, and unwavering faith. Many have begun but not all will finish well. Determine to remain faithful in all areas until the very end.
prayer_points: Father, grant me grace to endure every trial and to remain faithful to the end.
Father, destroy every power assigned to make me backslide.
Lord, establish my heart so I will not be moved by pressure, persecution or delay.
Father, help me to keep my crown and receive the reward prepared for the faithful.
O God, I receive grace not just to start well but to finish well.
golden_diet: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved. Matthew 24:13
Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life. Revelation 2:10
Blessed is the man that endureth temptation. James 1:12
Hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown. Revelation 3:11
For ye have need of patience, that ye might receive the promise. Hebrews 10:6
If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away. Colossians 1:22-23
Be ye steadfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord. 1 Corinthians 15:58

weeks.memory_verse: “And he said unto him, Well done, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities. Luke 19:17.
weeks.lesson_introduction: The Almighty God tests with little before trusting us with much. Men celebrate results, God celebrates faithfulness. In Luke 19, Jesus shows that God's promotion in the kingdom is not accidental - it is the reward for faithfulness in seemingly small matters.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: FAITHFUL IN LITTLE
outlines.body:
God will always trust in little before committing much into His children's hands. David was trusted in little assignment of taking care of his father's sheep and he succeeded. Are you committed to that little assignment God has given you? Little is the classroom of greatness.

What is faithfulness?
Doing the right thing when no one is watching.
Being consistent when no one is watching, serving God when it seems unnoticed.
Being diligent when the environment is discouraging. Heaven takes records of small daily obedience.
Get going when others are surrendering to the dictates of the flesh. Proverbs 1:10.
Not allowing the perilous time to swallow what God has assigned to you as divine tasks. Gehazi succumbed to the lust of the eyes, Achan died because of the things of the world. 1 John 2:15-17

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: CONSEQUENCES OF BEING FAITHFUL
outlines.body:
Faithful in little shows your trust in God, your value for God's assignment.
It brings divine promotion. David moved from being a shepherd boy to becoming king of Israel.
It attracts more responsibility, more influence and more open doors.
Faithful in little receives divine boosting in character, stewardship, integrity and consistency.
It promotes greatness. Joseph assumed greatness through his act of faithfulness.
It attracts more gains of resources, and opportunities.

weeks.conclusion: God is watching what you do with the little in your hands, little doors open big palaces, and little obedience births big testimonies. David was called to play the instrument for king Saul, and without hesitation he did and gained access to God's mind.
prayer_points: Father, as I remain faithful in little let my life qualify for divine enlargement and promotion.
Father, destroy every spirit of carelessness or negligence assigned to ruin my life.
Lord, help me to serve you joyfully and faithfully in every responsibility.
Father, deliver me from the spirit of despising small beginnings.
O God, grant me the grace to value every assignment You gave me.
golden_diet: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much. Luke 16:10
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily as to the Lord and not unto men. Colossians 3:23
A faithful man shall abound with blessings. Proverbs 28:20
For who hath despised the day of small things? Zechariah 4:10.
Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might. Ecclesiastes 9:10
Moreover it is required in stewards that a man be found faithful. 1 Corinthians 4:2
Thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things. Matthew 25:21

weeks.memory_verse: “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.” Genesis 2:24
weeks.lesson_introduction: The world had never experienced the kind of darkness ravaging homes and destinies of men as we have it today. There is a massive resurgence of ungodliness in families, communities and lack of respect for the Creator of the universe. This must not continue in our families, we must end it. The simplest way of dealing with the darkness ravaging homes is the application of light, having heavenly bound, spirit filled members in each family.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: QUALITIES OF HEAVEN BOUND HOME
outlines.body:
The attributes of a heaven- bound home are:
Raising family altar on daily basis.
Having undiluted passion for things of God.
Creating solutions in difficult situations.
Resisting ungodly association and unruly behavior.
Making provision for dying, perishing souls, inviting others to the narrow way to heaven. John1:45
Taming demonic operations that can bring the spreading of darkness.
Living a sacrificial life. Romans 12:1-2, 2 Corinthians 12:15
Onward movement soldiers that ensure unstoppable revival. Luke 9:62

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: EFFECTIVENESS OF GODLY HOME
outlines.body:
A Christian home is born when two children of God come together in marriage. A Christian home will not happen just because you are anointed, it demands diligence, commitment and sacrifice.
Requirements for godly home are rooted in:

· God's guidance and direction. Proverbs 3:5-6.
· Maintaining purity and sanctity of marriage. Hebrews 13:4
· Rejecting worldly influences, avoid the pursuit of worldly values. 1 John 2:15-17.
· Upholding biblical values. 2 Corinthians 6:14.
· Understanding each other's strengths and weaknesses.
· Having effective communication
· Having provision to forgive each other's flaws, not creating room for secrecy. Eph. 4:32, Gen. 2:25-26.

weeks.conclusion: Matthew 5:14 says we are light. Every heaven -bound home should shine as light, shining brightly for others to see and glorify God in love and purity.
prayer_points: Father, let our family be anchored on heavenly values.
Father, let righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Ghost dwell in our home.
Lord, draw every member of my family to Your salvation.
Father, let decisions and resources in every family glorify your name.
Father, protect my home and family from every worldly influence thatcan hinder our journey to heaven.
golden_diet: The Almighty God is the foundation of every home. Psalm 127:1
Godly upbringing ensures a heaven focused family. Proverbs 22:6
As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Joshua 24:15
Heaven bound home is marked by unity and peace. Psalm 133:1
Daily instruction in God's word creates a heaven bound family. Deuteronomy 6:5-7
Godly parenting fosters a heaven-oriented household. Ephesians 6:4
Worldly distractions can interrupt God's will for a heaven -bound home. Matthew 6:19-21

weeks.memory_verse: “Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore, despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty : Job 5:17
weeks.lesson_introduction: Despise not is one of the key words in the scripture, This serves as a warning and it should not be treated as unimportant. It is a call to honour and value a person, an instruction, a gift, or situation. It should be taken seriously, it should not be despised, it may be a pointer to your deliverance.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: UNDERSTANDING 'DESPISE NOT'
outlines.body:
God is sounding this information to everyone never to despise, ignore His divine order or instructions. Despise not means
Never belittle God's word or godly counsel. Proverbs 1:10.
Don't treat information from God's throne lightly. 1 Samuel: 12-18. Eli despised God's instruction.
Never ignore values divine information carries. Joshua followed instruction given to him by God in bringing down the wall of Jericho. Joshua 6:2-21.
Never consider little assignment insignificant.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: DESPISE NOT WHAT OR WHO?
outlines.body:
In the kingdom of God, greatness often begins in small, hidden, quiet ways. God rarely starts with the spectacular, He begins with seeds of little instructions and guidance, not forests; with whispers, not thunder.
Despise not your small starts. David started as a shepherd boy and ended asa king.
Despise not divine instructions, they are simple but produce miracles. 2 kings 4:1-7.
Others like your stewards may be important on your way to the top. 2 kings 5:2-4, 14.
The grace and values in you too. David, Joseph and Daniel never despised the gifts of God in them
The chastening from the Lord. Proverbs 3:11
The poor or the needy. James 2:6. Romans 14:3
Despise not prophesyings. 1 Thessalonians 5:20

weeks.summary: God hides greatness in small packages, whatever God is doing in your life may look small, slow, or insignificant, but it is lasting.
weeks.conclusion: God is mighty, yet He does not despise anyone! He is mighty in both power and understanding, for the Lord heareth the poor and despiseth not his prisoners.
prayer_points: Father, help me never to despise small beginnings, tasks, or opportunities.
Father, remove from me every spirit of pride and arrogance.
Lord, help me to show love and kindness to all, never despising anyone.
Father, teach me to trust your timing and not despise small steps in my journey to greatness.
O God, I receive the grace to be diligent and faithful to the end.
golden_diet: Don't despise small responsibilities; faithfulness in little leads to greater things. Luke 16:10-12
God honours even the smallest beginning, never underestimate humble starts. Zechariah 4:10
Don't despise that which seems weak or insignificant, God can use it mightily. 1 Corinthians 1:27 29
God values every act of service even to the seeming insignificant. Matthew 25:40
Don't despise people because of appearances, God sees their worth. 1 Samuel 16:7
Don't despise small tasks; diligence in little matters brings God's reward. Ecclesiastes 9:10
He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord, don't despise people in need. Proverbs 19:17

weeks.overview: Give a copy of house fellowship manual to souls around and also go out and win soul for Christ.
prayer_points: Father, destroy every power that wants to commission my life to sorrow.
I reject evil spoken words issued against my destiny.
Covenant that brought hard times, life of struggles, reproach to me is destroyed.
Father, initiate the process of solution and intervention for my destiny.
Father, terminate any program of downward journey in my life.
golden_diet: Be determined to succeed, never receive NO for an answer.
Go to the source of your problems and address it. 2 kings 2:19-22.
Obedience will sustain your greatness. 1 Samuel 15: 18 22.
Maintain your stand with God, keep in lane.
Self-control and discipline is required. Genesis 49:5-7.
Have a perfect relationship with Almighty God.

weeks.opening_prayer: Lord, enlarge my capacity and give me the grace to hearken to Your instructions.
weeks.previous_knowledge: Leaders are to remind the members of the discussion on end of the first quarter.
weeks.memory_verse: “And he saith, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels, borrow not a few.” 2 kings 4:3
weeks.lesson_introduction: Go borrow vessels is a divine instruction to everyone, vessels that will be used to carry breakthroughs which will take care of needs beyond your reach. God always releases a prophetic command that unlocks abundance. This lesson reveals to us that the answer to our requests lies in obedience, preparation and faith in God.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHAT DO YOU HAVE?
outlines.body:
God works with what you present. The vessels mentioned in this lesson represents capacity and expectation
God will only fill what you make available.
Limited capacity equals limited results.
God cannot pour new oil into a closed or small vessel.

What God expects from you as vessel is;
a. Your faith. Hebrews 11:6
b. Your mindset and preparation. Luke 1:37, Phillipians 4:13
c. Your skills and opportunity. David rode on the opportunity and skill he had so as to conquer Goliath.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: FOLLOW DIVINE INSTRUCTIONS
outlines.body:
Many times, miracles do not come wrapped as miracles, they come as instructions. The size of your obedience determines the size of your manifestation. Go borrow vessels was the instruction and this means;
Movement precedes miracles.
God will crown your steps with success not your idleness.
Having faith without action is failure.
God starts with emptiness, not fullness

weeks.summary: When the widow obeyed, the oil flowed until the last vessel was filled. Your miracle is also waiting for your obedience, your capacity and your expectations.
prayer_points: Father, release supernatural provision in my life and household.
Father, deliver me from every form of lack and hopelessness.
Lord, make doors of opportunities to be open for me and my household.
Father, take the little I have and multiply it into abundance to meet my needs and to bless others.
O God, give me the grace to obey Your instructions fully even when they seem unusual.
golden_diet: Divine instruction may seem strange but follow it.
That little in your hand may set the pace to your abundance.
Faith without actions does not produce results.
Obedience leads to great results. Job 36:11
When you trust God, be expectant to receive special visitation. Proverbs 3:5-6.
God is able to make all grace abound towards His children. 2 Corinthians 9:8

weeks.memory_verse: “Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.” Proverbs 4:7
weeks.lesson_introduction: It is written, Wisdom is the principal thing, and we are admonished to get wisdom (Proverbs 4:7). Principal means important, consequential or influential. Wisdom is a must have for every believer which is why the Word of God tells us to ask the Lord for wisdom if we lack it (James 1:5). God expects us to place wisdom as a top priority in our desires. It is to be desired more than anything one may need in this world.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WISDOM IS THE PRINCIPAL THING
outlines.body:
Wisdom is the most important thing. While we are focusing on the principal thing, it is important to note that the wisdom referred to in our bible text is the wisdom that comes from God and brings life and peace and should not be mistaken for earthly wisdom which comes with envying and strife (James 3:14-16). The wisdom that comes from above possesses the following features:
1. Wisdom comes from God. Proverbs 2:6
2. Wisdom is pure, peaceable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and hypocrisy. James 3:16
3. Wisdom is better than rubies and nothing that one desires can be compared to her. Proverbs 8:11.
4. Wisdom is better than strength. Ecclesiastes 9:16.
5. Wisdom is better than weapons of war. Ecclesiastes 9:18.
6. Wisdom promotes and brings honour to those who embrace her. Proverbs 4:8.
7. Wisdom gives grace and the crown of glory. Proverbs 4:9.
8. Wisdom gives long life, riches and honour. Proverbs 3:16

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: WAYS TO ACCESS GOD'S WISDOM
outlines.body:
Know the wisdom of God - The Lord Jesus Christ. 1 Corinthians 1:24.
Ask God for wisdom. James 1:5
Fear God. Proverbs 1:7
Listen to wisdom. Proverbs 1:33, Proverbs 2:2, Proverbs 8:34
Seek for wisdom as a hidden treasure. Proverbs 2:4-6.
Love and seek wisdom early. Proverbs 8:17
Keep God's commandments. Ecclesiastes 12:1

weeks.conclusion: Wisdom is the principal thing. God is the source of wisdom and knowing Jesus Christ gives us access to the wisdom of God. God commands us to ask for wisdom and to listen to His instructions and obey His commandments to retain wisdom.
prayer_points: Father, thank You for Your word that we have learnt today.
Father, endow me with wisdom in Jesus' Name.
Father, help me to love You and obey Your commandments.
Father, help all people to know and seek you early in Jesus Name.
Father, endow all members of the RCCG with wisdom in Jesus' Name.
Father, endow our Father-in- the-Lord and our Mother-in-the Lord with wisdom to finish well in Jesus' Name.
Father, help all our leaders to walk in the fear of the Lord in Jesus' Name, Amen.
golden_diet: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God. James 1:5
In Him all treasures of wisdom and knowledge is hidden. Colossians 2:3
One thing is needful and Mary hath chosen that good part. Luke 10:42
Fear God and keep His commandments, for this is the whole duty of man. Ecclesiastes 12:13
Wisdom is the most essential thing in our daily lives. Proverbs 4:7
There is wisdom in seeking God first, prioritizing His kingdom. Matthew 6:33

weeks.memory_verse: “But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her”. Luke 10:42.
weeks.bible_text: Luke 10: 38-42 INTRODUCTION. One thing is needful, that's what Jesus says to Martha in Luke 10:38-42. Five verses that spoke about two sisters with polar opposite of attitudes and actions. From it, we learned about what Jesus desire from us above all things.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: PRIORITIZE FELLOWSHIP WITH GOD
outlines.body:
Mary was commended by the Lord for her choice to seek His face, sit at His feet and soak up His word. She chose the good part and He was not going to pull her away from that intimate time with Him. Martha had a choice too, but she was focused on the physical service to the Lord rather than on the spiritual sustenance she could receive from Jesus.
Mary had a heart to worship and Martha had a mind to work. The most beneficial thing we can do is to worship Jesus. Does that mean we should drop all our other responsibilities and sit around to read the Bible all day? Of course not, the Lord saved is to do good works, evangelize and disciple. (Ephesians 2:20, Matthew, 28:29-20, Titus. 2:3-5) But worship should always come first. Psalm. 73:25 KJV. Whom have I in heaven but thee? And there is none upon Earth that I desire beside thee.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: GAINS OF FELLOWSHIP WITH GOD
outlines.body:
Gains of fellowship with God includes:
1. Spiritual growth: Fellowship places you on a pathway for cultivating spiritual growth by learning from each other and growing in your faith. (Heb. 10:25
2. Deeper understanding: It deepens your understanding of God's love and strengthens your relationship with Him.1 John, 4:8
3. Biblical foundation: Fellowship encourages you to look to the word of God for understanding, as opposed to introspection. Heb. 4:12.
4. Unity and love: Fellowship builds unity among believers, encouraging harmony and acceptance despite differences. It provides opportunities for practicing sacrificial love, kindness, forgiveness and serving others. Psalm 131:1-2

Dangers of missing fellowship:
Missing fellowship with God can lead to spiritual decline such as:
Loss of spiritual support: You miss out support and encouragement from the community of believers which is vital for spiritual growth especially during difficult times. Proverbs 27:17
Spiritual weakness: Without regular spiritual nourishment and correction from the scripture, a person can become spiritually weak and susceptible to sin and negative influences. Heb. 12:6.
Increased temptation: As you move away from fellowship with God, you become vulnerable to the "works of darkness'' and ''vain and sinful pressures'' of the world. 1 John. 2:15-17.

weeks.conclusion: And one thing is needful and Mary hath chosen that good part. It is therefore expedient for you and me to choose to serve God in truth and in spirit, in worship, in obedience to His word and in fellowship with the brethren because it is a command. (Hebrews 10:25)
prayer_points: Father, create in me a deep hunger and thirst for Your world.
Father, give every believer listening heart that sits at Your feet and hears you audibly.
Father, help me to value eternal things above temporary concerns and pleasures.
Father, deliver me from unnecessary distractions and anxieties that can draw my heart from You.
Father, keep the fire in Daddy and Mummy G.O burning till You come.
golden_diet: Labour not for the meat which perisheth but for that meat which endureth. John 6:27
If ye be risen with Christ seek those things which are above. Colossians 3:1-2
This one thing I do forgetting those things which arebehind...Phil. 3:13
God expects full attention from His children. Friday:
For God gives the desire of His children's heart, everything they ask for.
God may allow the spoken and unspoken thoughts to be pleasing unto Him.

weeks.memory_verse: “...and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth”. Genesis 1:28.
weeks.bible_text: Joshua 1:3-8 INTRODUCTION. Dominion is God's delegated authority to all His children redeemed by the blood of His Son, Jesus'. It is an authority given to believers to represent Almighty God on earth with the mandate to execute divine will and establish God's counsel to mankind. Man was made by God to rule, subdue and overcome; therefore, every child of the Most High God has the DNA of dominion.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: DOMINION
outlines.body:
Dominion originated from the word DOMAIN, an area where authority is exercised, a field or realm of operation, a territory someone rules. The world is our domain and as God's representative we are commissioned with divine authority to rule and reign. In Revelation 5:10, bible says God has made us believers priest and king to reign on earth. Dominion is not automatic; it must be activated by declaring it and walking in righteousness.

Dominion requires waking up to responsibility. In Genesis God gave man the responsibility to tend, to guard and manage. In Genesis 2:15, Dominion is enforced through spiritual understanding. In Hosea 4:6, God expects His children to take responsibility for your domain by exercising godly influence and effect your ruling in that space. You are made to be masters over everything God made; that is what you are made for.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: GET DOMINION
outlines.body:
In Luke 10:19, bible says ''Behold, I have give you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over the power of the enemy, nothing shall by any means injure you'' Dominion is exercised through;
a. The Word of God.
b. Faith in God and His Word. Hebrews 11:6
c. Obedience. Job 36:11
d. Diligence and flawless commitment. 1 Samuel 17, Proverbs 22:29.
e. Prayer. Luke 18:1

Dominion is rooted in having identity as God's children. When you understand your identity in God:
Life of it Cannot Be Done disappears. Philippians 4:13. Inferiorty complex vanishes. Just like Joshua and Caleb declared possibility in Numbers 14 Authority becomes natural and daily manifestation. David brought down Goliath. Fear loses its grip.

weeks.conclusion: God has not called us to be dominated by fear, sin, sickness, and poverty or darkness (act of the devil). In Christ, you are restored, authorized and empowered therefore stand in your God - given dominion and reign in life.
prayer_points: Father, I receive the grace to walk in dominion You have ordained for me.
Father, subdue every power contending with my God -given dominion.
Father, open my eyes to the knowledge of Your word that establishes dominion and authority.
Father, grant me dominion over sin, the flesh and every weakness that seeks to rule my life.
Father, let Your fire consume every chain hindering me from exercising my dominion.
golden_diet: God has made His children kings and priests to reign on earth. Revelation 5:10.
Everything has been put under His feet and also the head over all things. Ephesians 1:19-22
By His divine intervention, we have been delivered from the power of darkness. Colossians 1:13.
Behold I give you power over all the power of the enemy. Luke 10:19.
All power in heaven and on earth is in the custody of our Lord Jesus. Matthew 28:18
God has made us to have dominion over the works of His hands. Psalm 8:4

weeks.memory_verse: “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it”. Matthew 16:18.
weeks.lesson_introduction: In Leviticus 26:7, bible says the unstoppable assembly shall chase their enemies and their enemies shall fall by the sword before them; an unstoppable assembly is not defined by numbers, 2 Chronicles 20:1-20, weapons or human strength but by having divine backing, unity, unalloyed dedication and a sense of purpose to the call or assignment. They are God-led. In Exodus 13:21 bible says God went before Israel as a pillar of fire and cloud. Their victory was guaranteed because they carried divine presence and they move with God.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: THERE IS A PROMISE
outlines.body: An unstoppable assembly has the promise of God's presence, Hebrews 13:5, God's interventions, Jeremiah 32:27, divine deliverance from the lion's den or fiery furnace. This army makes wonders through their faith in God's ability, they are more than conquerors, Romans 8:37, and they can subdue nations and kingdoms, Hebrews 11:33-34. They carry a spiritual fire and an heavenly authority, in Joel 2:3 bible says fire devours before them, nothing escapes, and they can tread on scorpions, serpents and will never be hurt. Luke 10:19 But they are a disciplined people. In 2 Timothy 2:3-4, bible says a good soldier avoids entanglement, Discipline keeps the unstoppable assembly strong and focused.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: UNSTOPPABLE ASSEMBLY IS EMPOWERED
outlines.body:
In Zechariah 4:6, bible says it is not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit says the Lord of hosts. Every assembly may be physically prepared but only the empowered assembly is unstoppable. God does not send His people to battle empty handed, He empowers them.
What are they empowered with?
With His Spirit. Acts 10:38.
With His presence. Hebrews 13:5
With His authority. Luke 10:19.
With His strength. Philippians 4:13.

When they are empowered, they become fearless, Daniel 3, obedient, Isaiah 1:19, they produce great results, 2 kings 4:1-7, they restore perfect order, Luke 7:11-15, they exercise their authority and flee, run away from all appearances of evil. 1 Thessalonians5:22, 1 Timothy 6:11, 2 Timothy 2:22.

weeks.conclusion: God's unstoppable assembly is not defined by size but by divine empowerment. When the Spirit of God rests upon His assembly, barriers crumble, enemies scatter, fiery furnaces become air conditioned, and territories submit
prayer_points: Father, enlist me in your end time army and make me a vessel fit for your use.
Father, clothe your children with power, boldness and fire of the Holy Ghost.
Father, let every opposition standing against Your army be scattered.
Father, strengthen your children to stand firm to the end without compromise.
Father, let Your fire detach everything that negates fulfilment of Your children's assignment.
golden_diet: Through the name of Jesus, an unstoppable assembly works wonders. Psalm 44:5
In all these things we face in life, we are more than conquerors. Romans 8:37
God wroughts great miracles through His anointed people.
To succeed in a divine assignment, you need to put on the whole armour of God. Ephesians 6:11-1
Gates of hell cannot prevail against His church. Matthew 16:18
God knows how to handle adversaries and their wicked plots. 2 Chronicles 20:1-20

weeks.memory_verse: “And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also; Acts 17:6.
weeks.bible_text: Acts 4:29-33 INTRODUCTION. In every life, there is a moment when everything changes, goals, careers, decisions that shift the outcome of things. In life and destiny, God specializes in game changing moments. When God comes into an awkward situation, the rule changes, the direction and end result will also change. Game changer can turn night to morning, sorrow to joy and sickness to wholeness.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: THE ALMIGHTY IS THE GAME CHANGER
outlines.body:
In every situation of life, there comes a moment when human strength ends. That moment is where the Almighty God steps in as the Game Changer.
God can overrule demonic decisions, laws and verdicts. 2 Chronicles 20.
God can break in for His children to breakthrough. Exodus 14.
The Almighty God can turn frustration to celebration. Luke 5. Peter's toiling turned great abundance.
When God steps in prison doors can open without humans operating them. Acts 16:25-26.
God has the capacity to change times and seasons. Daniel 2:21.
He has the ability to change stories and identity. Genesis 30:22. Luke 1:37, Acts 10. God changed the identities of Rachel and Zechariah's and Cornelius.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD INSPIRED GAME CHANGERS
outlines.body:
Let's us look at the special attributes of God inspired game changers.
They pray in the face of trials and temptations, they turn challenges to testimonies. Daniel 6:20-23
They are bold and trigger divine responses. Daniel 3:16-26
They are known for exceptional power and commands supernatural signs. Acts 4:30
They experience and enjoy divine visitation. Acts 12:7-11
They are filled again and again with the Holy Ghost. Acts 4:31.
They operate in great grace. Acts 4:33

weeks.conclusion: God is the known Game Changer and He has endowed His children to continue too, without fear, with power that produces destiny- shifting testimonies.
prayer_points: Father, arise and change every negative pattern in my life.
Every power assigned to keep me stagnant be overturned In Jesus' Name.
Father, empower me to become game changer in Jesus' Name.
Father, announce Your glory in my life.
O God of turnaround, please visit me this season in Jesus' Name.
golden_diet: God raises the poor from the dust and lifts the beggar from the ashes. 1 Samuel 2:8
The Game changer has the capacity to turn mourning to dancing. Psalm 30:11
God has the capacity to do a new thing. Isaiah 43:19.
With great power, He empowers His own to minister. Acts4:29-30
He has put down the mighty from their thrones and exalted the lowly. God alters status.
God empowers His people to change their generation.

weeks.memory_verse: “And when the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not”. Luke 7:13
weeks.bible_text:
Luke 7:11-15

INTRODUCTION. HOPELESS means a state where a person feels that there is no possibility of improvement, help, or positive change. It is the feeling that a situation is beyond solution or recovery. To be hopeless is to believe that nothing good will happen again, efforts are useless, Luke 5:1-7, future holds no promise but when hope is enacted the future promises will be established and efforts will be compensated with fruitful results.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: GOD KNOWS THE HOPELESS
outlines.body:
In our bible text, there was a story of the widow of Nain about to bury her only child when Jesus stepped in. Luke 7:11-15. What does God see in that hopeless situation?
He sees success in frustrating challenges. Luke 5:1-7
He sees life in dead situation. Luke 7:11-17, Mark 5
He sees freedom in that prison of life. Acts 16:25-26.
He sees Goliath and Haman being subdued and conquered.
He sees the recovery of losses. Joel 2:25-28.
He sees children and not dead wombs. Genesis 30:22

Hopeless situations are never hidden from God, He sees and acts, you may feel forgotten but you are never forsaken.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: HOW CAN ONE REGAIN OR OBTAIN HOPE?
outlines.body:
Hope can be restored or regained through:
The mercy of God. Lamentations 3:22-23, bible says it is of the Lord's mercies we are not consumed.
Your seed of commitment in God's service.
Prayer and ceaseless supplication.
Rugged faith. Mark 5:25-34. Faith connects God's children to God's power.
Divine intervention. Luke 7:11-15. Jesus stopped the funeral and restored life.
Declaration of God's Word. Philippians 4:13, Psalm 107:20. Hope grows when we believe God's Word.
God's act of kindness. John 9:1-5.
A Life of joy and peace.

EXAMPLES OF HOPELESS SITUATIONS THAT RECEIVED HOPE.
Hannah - Barrenness turned to Joy. 1 Samuel 1:2, 10-20.
Joseph - From Prison to Palace. Genesis 39-41
Widow of Zarephath - Last Meal turned to overflow. 1 kings 17:8-16
The woman with the issue of blood - Chronic sickness was healed. Mark 5:25-34
Blind Bartimaues - Blindness to Vision. Mark 10:46-52

weeks.conclusion: If God is present, then your story is not over.
prayer_points: Father, breathe life into every dead situation in my life.
Father, by Your mercy turn my tears to testimonies.
Father, visit me with divine encouragement in my lowest moment.
Father, grant me the grace to hope again and rise again.
Father, let hope arise where help seems absent.
golden_diet: If God gives hope to a tree, He will surely give hope to man. Job 14:7
Hope reveals a discouraged soul. Psalm 42:11
God's mercy guarantees hope beyond affliction. Lamentations 3:31-32.
God brings hope to those that people have written off. Isaiah 49:24-25.
Waiting on God restores strength and hope. Isaiah 40:31
Hope stabilizes life in storms. Hebrews 6:19

weeks.memory_verse: “But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God said, behold my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but as the Lord liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him”. 2 Kings 5:20
weeks.bible_text: 2 Kings 5:1-27 INTRODUCTION. Opportunities are divine privileges. When God places His children near power, servants, and His work, He is giving them chance to grow in character and destiny had a rare opportunity - to serve a prophet, learn obedience, and inherit greatness - but he misused that opportunity and paid a heavy price. Opportunity can lift you or ruin you, depending on you handle it.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: OPPORTUNITY GIVES ACCESS
outlines.body:
Gehazi had opportunity to work with great prophet of Most High(Elijah), witnessed great miracles and made kings. Many prayed for such access but Gehazi treated it casually, in Matthew 22:14, bible says many are called but few are chosen.
BENEFITS OF USING OPPORTUNITY GIVEN
It leads to destiny fulfilment. David became king through opportunity of defeating Goliath.
It builds character and maturity. Luke 16:10.
It attracts divine promotion and prevents future regret. James 4:10
It releases God's favour. Ruth gained favour from Boaz.
BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF THOSE THAT UTILISED THEIR OPPORTUNITY.
David - destroyed Goliath through the opportunity. 1 Samuel 17.
Mordecai and Esther - filled the vacancy in the palace of king Ahasuerus. Esther 4:14
Caleb - got Hebron by defending God's mandate. Numbers 14:
Abraham - Got a new name through obedience to God's instruction.
Daniel and three Hebrew boys. Daniel 3 & 6

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: THE PRICE OF MISUSED OPPORTUNITY
outlines.body:
Gehazi gained Naaman's curse through covetousness, “the leprosy shall cleave unto thee and unto thy seed forever” 2kings 5:27. What you gained dishonestly will eventually destroy what you value most.
What is the price for the misused opportunities?
Loss of position. King Saul lost the throne to David
Loss of future. Samson lost glorious future to Delilah's lap.
Loss of legacy. Eli lost the legacy and God's mandate to indifference to his children bad behavior.
Loss of double portion of Elisha's anointing.
Life ended in shame
Loss of destiny. Lot lost his children destinies to lack of caution to in choosing Sodom and Gomorroh.
Loss of continuous victory over adversaries.

weeks.conclusion: Gehazi teaches that opportunity is a test. What you do when no one is watching determines whether your opportunity becomes a blessing or a curse. Do not misuse opportunity God has given you.
prayer_points: Father, restore every good opportunity I have misused knowingly or unknowingly.
I receive grace to recognize divine visitation when it comes.
Lord, don't let mistakes define my destiny but your mercy.
Father where other failed, let me succeed by divine wisdom.
I reject laziness and procrastination In Jesus Name.
golden_diet: Opportunities must be recognized and redeemed. Ephesians 5:15-16
Ignorance of divine visitation leads to loss. Luke 19:44
Misuse opportunity can cost destiny. Hebrew 12:16-17
Joseph preserved his opportunity by integrity. Genesis 39:9
Small opportunities prepare for greater ones. Luke 16:10

weeks.memory_verse: “And he said to them all, If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me”. Luke 9:23
weeks.bible_text:
Romans 12:1-2

INTRODUCTION. One of the greatest battles a believer fights is not against the devil, people or challenging issues, but against self. Self wants comfort like Jonah inside the raging storm, recognition like Absalom, and control like Korah, Dathan and Abiram and independence like the prodigal son. Until self is conquered, destiny will suffer and testimonies will be hindered.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHAT IS SELF?
outlines.body:
Self represents:
Lust of the eyes, of the flesh and the pride of life. 1 John 2:15
Personal will over God's will.
Ingratitude. Samson suffered from ingratitude to God.
Lack of commitment to divine purpose.
Being indifferent to divine counsel. Eli was indifferent and he suffered a terrible ending.

BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF LIFE DOMINATED WITH SELF.
Adam - Self destroyed dominion. Genesis 3:6
Saul - Self ruined his calling to kingship. 1 Samuel 15:24
Absalom - Self destroyed God's plan for him.
Lot - Self allowed him to make the wrong choice of staying in Sodom and Gomorrah.
Demas - loved things of this world and forsook God.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: HOW TO OVERCOME SELF?
outlines.body:
Let us look at how to address self and overcome it.
Being renewed daily by the word of God. John 17:17, Psalm 119:9,11
Daily walking in the Spirit. Galatians 5:16.
Choose humility. James 4:6
Renounce gathering of self.
Prioritize companies. 1 Corinthians 15:33
Crucify the flesh embracing the cross. Galatians 2:20

weeks.summary: When you overcome self, you will enjoy freedom from pride, deeper intimacy with God, greater spiritual authority and fulfilment of destiny.
weeks.conclusion: You cannot follow Christ and follow self at the same time. The throne of your heart can only have one ruler. When self steps down, Christ steps up.
prayer_points: Father, deliver me from the power of self that wars against Your will in my life.
Holy Spirit, subdue my flesh and strengthen my inner man.
Father, help me to rule my spirit and not be ruled by emotions.
Every pride and self-exaltation blocking my spiritual growth, be uprooted.
Father, give me the grace to deny myself and follow You daily.
golden_diet: Overcoming self allows Christ to reign. Galatians 2:20.
Self must die for Christ to be revealed. Colossians 3:3-5
Uncontrolled desires defeat spiritual progress. James 1:14-15
Self limitations are broken by divine power. 2 Timothy 1:7

weeks.week_heading: WEEK TWENTY THREE - THANKSGIVING SUNDAY, 7TH FEBRUARY 2027.
weeks.memory_verse: “For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith”. 1 John5:4
weeks.bible_text: 1 John 5:4-5 INTRODUCTION. Believers may be living in this world but they are not to live based on the worldly system, though the world system may pressure us to sin, fear, pride, lust, unbelief but as Christians we ought to take our stand in faith and purity of hearts. God never called us to be defeated by the world; He called us to overcome it. Overcoming the world and its system is not by human strength but by divine life and faith in Christ.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: JESUS OVERCAME THE WORLD
outlines.body:
In John 16:33, bible says in the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world.
Jesus paid the price of redemption for mankind by overcoming:
Sin and its wages. Romans 3:23 Your adversary the Devil (1 Peter 5:8.)
The flesh. 1 John 2:15-17

The victory received through the price Jesus paid made believers overcomers by;
Gaining access to eternal life. Revelations 12:11
Having authority with Christ.
Receiving crowns and glory.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: WHO ARE THE OVERCOMERS?
outlines.body:
Those that walk in the Spirit.
Those that carry the life of God.
Those that believe in the word of God.
Those that trust in God, depend on Christ.
Those that have confidence in God's promises.

HOW TO OVERCOME THE WORLD?
By the Word of God, the word renews the mind and strengthens the Spirit. Psalm 119:11.
-By the Spirit of God. Galatians 5:16. The Spirit empowers holy living.
By separation and discipline. 2 Corinthians 6:17. You cannot overcome what you continually embrace.

weeks.conclusion: The world may challenge you, but it cannot defeat you if you are in Christ. You are not fighting for victory, you are fighting from victory.
prayer_points: Father, empower me by the Holy Spirit to live above the pressures and temptations of this world.
I break free from every worldly attachment pulling my heart away from God.
Father, help me to love righteousness and hate iniquity in all its forms.
Lord, silence every voice of the world speaking defeat into my destiny.
Father, renew my mind daily to align with God's truth and not worldly deception.
golden_diet: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the Word of their testimony. Revelation 12:11
Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. 1 John 2:15-17
In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believeth not. 2 Corin. 4:4
Friendship of the world is enmity with God. James 4:4.
Greater is He that is in you, than he that is in the world. 1 John 4:4.
By whom the world is crucified unto Me, and I unto the world. Galatians 6:14

weeks.memory_verse: “When the righteous is in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn”. Proverbs 29:2.
weeks.bible_text:
Genesis 41:38-41

INTRODUCTION. Politics refers to the activities associated with the governance of a country or an area. Psalm 24:1 tells us that the earth belongs to our God and all the people that live in the world because He is the Maker, Deuteronomy 10:14. As the Owner and Maker of the earth, God remains in charge of the governance of every nation and kingdom (Psalm 47:2) but gives authority to men at different times to be in governance taking instructions from Him as the King of Kings. Daniel 2:21

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: IN THE BEGINNING
outlines.body:
The bible records that in the beginning God made the heavens and earth (Genesis 1:1), made Adam and gave him dominion to rule over all His creation. Genesis 1:28. And from Adam, God governed the kingdoms of the earth through His selected and appointed sons and daughters: Judges like Deborah, Gideon, and Samson were raised up by God as leaders in response to specific needs. Judges 2:16.
At various times God demonstrated His sovereignty over the whole earth by placing His sons and daughters in positions of power across the nations of the earth:
Joseph rose to political power in Egypt through God's interference in the affairs of that nation to save His people from famine. Genesis 41.
Daniel, a Jew, served in the courts of Babylon and Persia. Daniel 1-6.
Esther became a queen in Shushan and saved her people from genocide. Esther 4

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: THE PEOPLE'S CHOICE
outlines.body:
The children of Israel demanded for a king to be like other nations (1 Samuel 8:4-5) and God told Prophet Samuel to anoint Saul as king over Israel, 1 Samuel 8:22. That was the people's choices. However, because man's ways are not God's ways, man's ways are corrupt and wicked. Jeremiah 17:9, people's choice never result in good outcomes, 1 Samuel 8:11-21. All the admonitions of the Prophet Samuel came to pass when Saul became their king. He took over the land and the whole nation became his subjects which is what many nations are experiencing today because they refuse to allow God to choose their leaders so that He can rule through them.

We are admonished to always allow God to be in charge of the governance of our communities, cities, states, and nations for us to enjoy God's divine plan for peace and prosperity. Jeremiah 29:11, Proverbs 23:12-13

weeks.summary: God is the Owner and Ruler of the earth (Psalm 24:1) and has given His sons and daughters the privileges to run the affairs of the governance (Psalm 47:2). We must allow Him to choose our leaders so that He can rule through them. 1 kings 3:7-14.
weeks.conclusion: The plan of God for every nation of the world is to enjoy peace and live in prosperity (3 John vs2), under His divine governance. Jeremiah 32: 38-40. When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice because God will be governing them.
prayer_points: Father, we enthrone You as the King over nations.
Father, please take charge of the governance of our nation.
Father, please uproot every leader, whether male or female in authority that You have not appointed.
Father, help us to obey You in the appointment of our leaders.
Father, please let there be peace and prosperity in our nation.
golden_diet: And He changeth the times and the seasons; he removeth kings, and setteth up kings. Daniel 2:21
For the kingdom is the Lord's and he is the Governor among the nations. Psalm 22:28.
By Me kings reigns and princes decree justice. Proverbs 8:15 16
Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake. 1 Peter 2:13-14
Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and power. Titus 3:1
For our conversation is in heaven. Philippians 3:20

weeks.memory_verse: “When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn”. Proverbs 29:2.
weeks.bible_text: Daniel 6:3-5 INTRODUCTION. Politics refers to the activities associated with the governance of a country or area. Psalm 24:1 tells us that the earth belongs to our God and all the people that live in the world because He is the Maker, Deuteronomy 10:14. As the Owner and Maker of the earth, God remains in charge of the governance of every nation and kingdom (Psalm 47:2) but gives authority to men at different times to be in governance taking instructions from Him as the King of Kings. Daniel 2:21. We will be studying the biblical guideline for God's children in politics.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHY CHRISTIANS SHOULD PARTICIPATE IN POLITICS?
outlines.body:
Politics refers to the activities associated with the governance of a country or an area and these activities affect nearly every part of dailylife: the laws we obey, the rights we enjoy, the freedoms we cherish are determined by the leaders that govern. Proverbs 29:2, 1 Timothy 2:1-2.

Matthew 5:13-14 tells us that we are the salt of the earth which means that as Christians, we are to influence every sphere of society, including politics, with integrity, truth, grace and with our prayers. Jeremiah 29:7. At creation, God handed over the governance of the earth through His selected and appointed sons and daughters like Deborah, Gideon and Samson, Saul, David, Solomon. e.t.c.

As Christians, like king Solomon we are to take charge of the governance of our villages, cities, towns, states and countries for our Lord so that the people can rejoice and always give thanks to God for all His goodness. 1 Kings 4:21-25, our God is the Governor of all nations and is interested in rulership at all nation, Psalm 22:28 and He has handed over the governance to His sons and daughter of whom we are. Psalm 115:16

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: THE GUIDELINES
outlines.body:
As Christians we should get involved in politics with the banner of Jesus lifted up as the ambassadors of our Lord Jesus Christ, 2 Corinthians 5:20. As ambassadors for Christ, we should be shining examples for the Lord in politics and governance John 5:39; some of the guideline we should follow in our involvement:
· Let your light shine. Matthew 5:13-16. Christians are to influence society, including politics with integrity and truth. The light of God shone through Daniel 6:1-3.
Justice, mercy and humanity. Micah 6:8. Daniel humbled himself before the Lord. Daniel 9:3.
Faithfulness to God and accountability. 1 Timothy 4:12, 1 Corinthians 4:1-2.
Obedience to God above man. Acts 4:19-20.
Remember that you will give account of your stewardship. Colossians 3:2-24, Galatians 6:9, 2 Corin. 5:10

weeks.summary: As Christians our involvement in politics should be for good governance that will enhance the wellbeing of the people. When we follow the guidelines set out by God, the Owner of the heavens and the earth, our villages, cities, towns, states and countries will prosper and the people will rejoice and give God the glory.
weeks.conclusion: God is interested in the prosperity of all nations of the world that submit to His authority. Jeremiah 32:38-40.
prayer_points: Father, we enthrone You as the King over the nations.
Father, please take charge of the governance of our nation.
Father, please uproot every leader, whether male or female in authority that You have not appointed.
Father, please help us to shine Your light as Christians in the governance of our nation.
Father, please let our leaders lead us according to Your will for our nation.
golden_diet: They desired a better country, that is an heavenly place. Hebrews 11:13
When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice.Proverbs 29:2.
Seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives. Jeremiah 29:7
We ought to obey God rather than men. Acts 5:29.
The kingdom of God is not of this world. John 18:36.
Daniel continued to pray despite a political decree. Daniel 6:10.

weeks.overview: Hanging of House Fellowship Banners in Centres/ Exchange of Gifts as A Sign of Love and Unity
prayer_points: Father, give me humble heart to restrain from all forms of pride.
Lord by your mercy, please restore to me every blessing lost through pride.
Father, don't let your spirit of humility depart from Daddy and Mummy G.O
Father, give all RCCG members sacrificial heart towards kingdom growth.
Father, please cause your face to shine on me.

weeks.week_heading: WEEK TWENTY SEVEN- THANKSGIVING SUNDAY, 7TH MARCH, 2027.
weeks.memory_verse: “And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;” Genesis 18:17
weeks.bible_text:
Genesis 18:17-22

INTRODUCTION. In kingdom business people are evaluated as assets or liabilities depending on Your fellowship and closeness to the will of God. The Almighty God also assesses lives whether productive or inactive, God looks at individuals not by their wealth or status, but by their spiritual value, obedience and alignment with God's purpose.

outlines.label: One
outlines.title: WHERE DO YOU STAND, ASSET OR LIABILITY?
outlines.body:
A divine asset is the one that:
God trusts with secrets. Psalm 25:14.
Has been proven, faithful and walks in intimacy with God like Enoch did .
Influences God's action. Genesis 18:22.
That prays beyond personal needs and stands in the gap as a watchman. Exodus 22:30
Builds spiritual legacy and thinks beyond now.

A Liability is a believer that:
1. No longer advances God's purpose but instead hinders God's work. (John3vs9-10)
2. Lacks spiritual growth still remains a baby.
3. That cannot handle correction and deeper truth.
4. Disobeys God's word, knows the truth but refuses to act.
5. Is worldly in nature, compromises values and fears people more than God.

outlines.label: Two
outlines.title: ASSETS ARE PECULIAR
outlines.body:
Assets are peculiar because:
They have the burden for lost souls. Matthew 9:37.
They are kingdom-minded not activities or church centered.
They sacrifice to grow God's kingdom but not blessing oriented. Luke 18:18.
They obey spiritual leadership, cherishes accountability and follow order.
They are faithful in small commitment. Luke 16:10.
They are cautious in speech, humble and not arrogant.

weeks.conclusion: Heaven is still asking, ''is this person an asset or a liability ''to My agenda? God is not looking for perfection, but for availability, alignment, and intercession.
